family: The single total charged-prefix language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. Small lengths and failed explicit planning guards use the fixed legacy evaluator. At all sufficiently large actual lengths N the payload is evaluated by the supplied deterministic-tower linear condenser, streamed strong linear extractors, refreshed affine index/look-ahead construction, and robust almost-independent-bit function of disperser.md A1 and B1-B7. The entropy threshold is k=2^(56*ceil(log2(ceil(log2 N)))) and the entire data prefix P=k^(11/28+o(1)) consists of actual input bits encoding only the stated field moduli and traversing matrices. Large condenser extension fields are computed deterministically, not supplied as advice. Invalid prefixes still give total bounded ring/matrix evaluation. The payload is zero-padded injectively; no witness or per-length advice supplies construction data.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence NP with empty witnesses. Unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, for every sufficiently large integer actual length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-2^61*(log2 N)^56. The exact eventual loss is R(N)=4*P(N)+8*k(N), with k=2^(56*ceil(log2(ceil(log2 N)))) and P=k^(11/28+o(1)); every prefix bit is charged. More strongly, for every fixed real epsilon>0, this SAME family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-N^epsilon for all sufficiently large integer N. The supplied proofs establish all-length affine dispersal at dimension k, the full-B2 finite bound4n-8d, uniform polynomial-time evaluation and the stated exact input accounting.
